reading.title: The Demo Is Tomorrow

sentences.en: How many things can go wrong before tomorrow's demo?
sentences.zh: 明天演示之前能出多少岔子？

sentences.en: The list of open bugs is longer than my arm.
sentences.zh: 未修复 bug 的清单比我的手臂还长。

sentences.en: Every one of the services needs a restart.
sentences.zh: 每一个服务都需要重启。

sentences.en: Neither the database nor the caches were refreshed, so the pages show old data.
sentences.zh: 数据库和缓存都没刷新过，所以页面显示旧数据。

sentences.en: "Each of you owns a piece of this," our lead says at the standup.
sentences.zh: "你们每个人都拥有这个问题的一块，"负责人在站会上说。

sentences.en: Ten minutes plus one forgotten test is a recipe for panic, and there is less time than we think.
sentences.zh: 十分钟加一个被遗忘的测试，就是恐慌的配方，而时间比我们想的少。

sentences.en: Mathematics says we can make it; the calculator on my desk disagrees.
sentences.zh: 数学说我们能搞定；我桌上的计算器不同意。

sentences.en: Everybody is fixing something, and nobody is drinking coffee.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在修点什么，没人在喝咖啡。

sentences.en: Luckily, my butler never panics: it keeps checking the caches every minute and sends me a summary.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我的管家从不慌张：它每分钟检查一次缓存，还给我发摘要。

reading.translation: 明天演示之前能出多少岔子？让我数数。未修复 bug 的清单比我的手臂还长。每一个服务都需要重启。数据库和缓存都没刷新过，所以页面显示旧数据。"你们每个人都拥有这个问题的一块，"负责人在站会上说。十分钟加一个被遗忘的测试，就是恐慌的配方，而时间比我们想的少。数学说我们能搞定；我桌上的计算器不同意。每个人都在修点什么，没人在喝咖啡。幸运的是，我的管家从不慌张：它每分钟检查一次缓存，还给我发摘要。

keyPoints.sentence: The list of open bugs is longer...
keyPoints.analysis: 真主语是 list（单数）— of open bugs 只是修饰，不许带偏谓语

keyPoints.sentence: Neither the database nor the caches were refreshed...
keyPoints.analysis: neither...nor 就近原则：谓语跟最近的主语 caches（复数）→ were

keyPoints.sentence: Every one of the services needs...
keyPoints.analysis: every one 单数 → needs；"of the services" 是干扰

keyPoints.sentence: Ten minutes plus one forgotten test is...
keyPoints.analysis: 时间 / 金钱作整体 = 单数（意义一致）

core.extraExample: The demo runs on a clean machine.
core.extraExampleZh: 演示在干净的机器上跑。

core.example: Neither the database nor the caches...
core.extraExample: The database is down, and the phones keep ringing.

core.extraExample: A calculator settles every argument about numbers.
core.extraExampleZh: 计算器能平息一切关于数字的争论。

or / nor / either...or / not only...but also 跟**最近**的主语

notes.heading: 高频陷阱表（先划掉修饰，再看主语）

rows: Every one of us **have** a key.
Every one of us **has** a key.

blocks.text: there be 就近规则：be 的单复数跟**后面第一个名词**（There is a server and two clients ✅ / There are two clients and a server ✅）。

output.prompt: 用 3 句复述课文，其中 1 句必须含 neither...nor 就近结构。
output.reference: 线索：bug 清单 → 服务需重启 → 数据库与缓存未刷新（neither...nor）→ 人人都在修
output.sample:
The list of open bugs is longer than my arm, and every one of the services needs a restart. （语法一致：list / every one 均单数）Neither the database nor the caches were refreshed, so the pages show old data. （就近：caches → were）Everybody is fixing something, but my butler never panics. （不定代词单数）
（范文仅供参考：3 句覆盖课文要点、含 1 句 neither...nor 即可，不要求逐词一致。）

output.prompt: 描述你的项目现状 5 句，覆盖 5 个陷阱。
output.reference:
参考起点：
The list of failed tests is getting shorter.
Every one of the services has its own database.
Neither the frontend nor the backend APIs are ready.
Two hours of debugging is enough for today.
Nobody likes a Friday deploy.
output.sample:
The list of failed tests is getting shorter. （介词短语隔离 → 真主语 list）
Every one of the services has its own database. （every one 单数）
Neither the frontend nor the backend APIs are ready. （就近：backend APIs 复数 → are）
Two hours of debugging is enough for today. （意义一致：时间整体）
Nobody likes a Friday deploy. （不定代词单数）

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 5 句各触发一个不同的陷阱；主题是你的项目现状

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 每句先划掉介词短语再查谓语 — 真主语找对了吗；就近句确认谓语跟最近的主语

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 5 句主谓全部一致，即通过

questions.stem: The list of pending tasks ___ getting longer.
questions.explanation: is — 真主语 list（of pending tasks 是修饰）

questions.stem: Every one of the tickets ___ assigned.
Ten minutes of debugging ___ enough for now.
questions.explanation: is — 时间段作整体（意义一致）

questions.stem: Neither the backend nor the frontend APIs ___ ready.
questions.explanation: are — 就近原则：最近的主语 APIs 复数

questions.stem: There ___ a cache server and three databases in the rack.
questions.explanation: is — there be 就近：最近名词 a cache server 单数

questions.stem: The team ___ divided on this design.（按成员个体）
questions.explanation: are — team 按成员个体理解（意义一致；作整体时用 is）

practice.title: 找真主语 — 划出主语，判断谓语该单还是复

questions.stem: The number of open bugs is/are scary.
questions.explanation: The number（单）→ is — the number of + 复数名词 = 数量本身，单数

questions.stem: A number of bugs is/are still open.
questions.explanation: A number of bugs → are — a number of = 许多，真主语 bugs

questions.stem: The quality of the logs depends/depend on the verbosity.
questions.explanation: The quality（单）→ depends — depends on 固定搭配，主语 quality

questions.stem: The list of tasks are long.
questions.reference: The list of tasks is long.

questions.explanation: neither of + 复数正式用法取单数

questions.stem: Every developer and manager have a key.
questions.reference: Every developer and manager has a key.
questions.explanation: every A and B 结构 = 单数

practice.title: 就近造句 — 用 neither...nor 和 not only...but also 各造一句，让两个主语的单复数不同，体会就近原则

questions.stem: 用 neither...nor 和 not only...but also 各造一句，让两个主语的单复数不同，体会就近原则。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 示例：Neither the PM nor the developers were happy.（就近 developers）；Not only the cache but also the database is corrupted.（就近 database 单数）

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 谓语必须与第二个主语（最近者）一致；两句的两个主语单复数须不同，否则考查不到就近

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 两句就近一致均正确且两个主语单复数不同，即通过

practice.title: 短文判断 — 下列 5 处画线部分，判断正误，错的改正

questions.stem: 下列 5 处画线部分，判断正误，错的改正。短文：Everybody in our team have a clear role. The list of open bugs were long last week, but each of them is fixed now. There is two databases and a cache behind the firewall. Ten servers needs a restart, and neither the docs nor the runbook has been updated.

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: ① Everybody in our team has a clear role（不定代词单数）；② The list of open bugs was long last week（主语 list，过去语境）；③ each of them is fixed ✓ 正确；④ There are two databases and a cache behind the firewall（就近 two databases 复数）；⑤ Ten servers need a restart（真主语 servers 复数；neither...nor... has been updated ✓ 就近 runbook 正确）

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 每处先划掉介词短语定位真主语，再用三大原则核对谓语单复数

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 5 处判断全部正确且改正句正确，即通过
